subject: Pilot assessment & POC playbook — model roster, success criteria, next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@healthplus.ai>, Sara Chen <sara@healthplus.ai>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot assessment & POC playbook — model roster, success criteria, next steps

Hi Jamal / Sara —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on the clinical triage use case and the multilingual support needs (EN / ES / PT-BR + occasional FR). To make the POC high-value and low-friction, I sketched a short pilot assessment / POC playbook below with proposed owners, timeline, success criteria and the initial model roster. Please review and flag anything you'd like changed.

Short summary of intent
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for triage assistant prototypes across accuracy, latency and cost for English and Spanish production-like prompts.
- Duration: 4 weeks of hands-on evaluation after environment setup.
- Success: demonstrable uplift vs current baseline on intent accuracy + latency SLA met for p95.

Proposed model roster (initial):
- Primary model: Mistral-Instruct-22B (open, strong instruction-following, good low-latency on quantized paths) — targeted for production-quality responses
- Fallback/Cost-optimized: Llama-2-7B Q4 (quantized) — cheaper for lower-criticality interactions and bursts
- Safety/guardrail model: Falcon-40B-instruct (higher-perf hallucination checks run server-side during evaluation)
- Note: We'll provision a small multilingual tuning/lexicon pass for ES/PT-BR to reduce token-level translation drift.

Evaluation plan & acceptance criteria
- Dataset: 500 representative prompt-response pairs across EN/ES/PT with golden labels (we can start with the sample_prompts.csv attached).
- Quality: Intent accuracy >= 92% (micro), average helpfulness >= 4.2/5 on a 100-sample human review, hallucination incidents < 2% of responses.
- Latency: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 750ms (end-to-end in Redwood hosted trial environment)
- Cost: Target blended inference cost < $0.006 per 1k tokens across the roster (we'll produce cost estimates in week 0).

Ownership & next steps (this week)
- HealthPlus: deliver 500-sample evaluation set and confirm procurement contact for SOC2 paperwork (Action: Jamal / Sara).
- Redwood: (Neha) finalize SOW + kickoff agenda; (Dylan) provision trial stack and quantized model variants; (Monica) assemble SOC2 pointer and draft evaluation rubric.

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (setup, 3 business days): environment, model provisioning, data ingestion run
- Week 1–4 (evaluation): synthetic and live testing, weekly check-ins (Tue mornings)
- Week 5 (wrap): results, recommended rollout plan or further tuning

Attachments & links
- Attached: POC-scope-v1.pdf, sample_prompts.csv, SOC2-SelfAttestation.pdf
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Please reply with any edits to the acceptance criteria or the roster. If this looks OK we'll schedule a 30-min kickoff on Monday to confirm data deliverables and access.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@healthplus.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot assessment & POC playbook — model roster, success criteria, next steps

Thanks Neha — appreciate the concise plan. A few quick clarifications: 

1) Timeline: Week 0 as 3 business days is fine, but our engineering lead is offline Friday; can we shift kickoff to Monday 12/13 so Week 1 starts 12/14?
2) Dataset: we'll deliver the first tranche (150 labeled samples) by Thu 12/9 and the rest by 12/17. Is incremental ingestion OK?
3) Security: procurement needs a SOC2 attestation and an architecture diagram that shows no PHI is persisted. I've CC'd procurement@healthplus.ai on this thread.

On models: we like Mistral-Instruct-22B as the primary — good call. Curious about the fallback model behavior: can Redwood route low-confidence queries automatically to Llama-2-7B to save cost and still surface the primary model when confidence is high? Also we want to avoid cross-region fallback to keep data jurisdiction in NA.

Budget: our finance owner flagged that blended inference costs need to be modeled vs our current vendor — can you include a simple per-1k-token pro-forma for the roster?

I'll confirm the 12/13 kickoff after checking calendars. Procurement will follow up separately for SOC2 and the DocuSign SOW.

Best,
Jamal Ortiz
Product Lead, HealthPlus AI

All looks good from our side. Confirmed: we will deliver the first tranche of 150 labeled prompts by Thu 12/9 and aim to have the full 500 by 12/17. Jamal confirmed he will lock calendars and we can do kickoff Monday 12/13 at 11:00am PT. Procurement will follow up separately with SOC2 ask and DocuSign SOW (procurement@healthplus.ai).

Requested additions for kickoff agenda:
- Quick live demo of routing & fallback behavior (5–10m)
- Access & data handoff checklist (who uploads labels, where)
- Perf/cost baseline run summary (Dylan)
- Eval rubric walkthrough (Monica)

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
